project_name.justification: The authoritative metadata and the article title confirm the project name: "Collective Metals Announces Option Agreement to Acquire 70% of Princeton Project in Southeastern British Columbia".

company_name.justification: The buyer is identified in the text: "COLLECTIVE METALS INC. (CSE:COMT| FSE:TO1) (the “Company” or “Collective”), is pleased to announce it has signed an option agreement dated May 9, 2023 to acquire 70% of the Princeton Project..."

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the acquiring company is named in the text: "Christopher Huggins, Chief Executive Officer of Collective, commented..."

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The agreement is for an option to acquire a 70% interest: "Collective has secured an option on the Project from Tulmeen to earn a seventy percent (70%) interest in the Project..."

primary_commodity.justification: The project is described as a copper-gold project: "...to acquire 70% of the Princeton Project (the “Acquisition”), a copper-gold project located in south-central BC..."

verified_article_link.justification: No article link was provided in the source text.

currency.justification: The currency is specified as Canadian dollars for related payments in the text: "...for total consideration of CDN$200,000." and "...each with an exercise price of CDN$0.15..."

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total cash payment is the sum of scheduled payments: "paying Tulmeen an aggregate of $500,000 in cash as follows: (i) $50,000... (ii) $25,000... (iii) $100,000... (iv) $162,500... and (v) $162,500..."

share_payments_raw.justification: The consideration includes a number of shares, but not a cash value equivalent for those shares, so this field is null.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: Cash and share payments are listed as separate components, not as a single combined value.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The total number of shares to be issued is the sum of scheduled issuances: "issuing to Tulmeen an aggregate of 7,000,000 common shares (“Shares”) as follows: (i) 1,000,000 Shares... (ii) 1,500,000 Shares... (iii) 2,000,000 Shares... and (iv) 2,500,000 Shares..."

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The warrants mentioned are part of a "Correction Notice of Press Release dated March 24, 2023 - Announcing Closing of Non-Brokered Private Placement of Units" and not part of the Princeton acquisition terms.

option_payments_raw.justification: The options mentioned are "incentive stock options (“Options”) under the Company’s stock option plan... to officers, directors and consultants of the Company," not as payment for the project.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued (7,000,000), but not the price. Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.05'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: No exploration commitment in terms of drilling meters is mentioned in the agreement.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The total exploration commitment is the sum of scheduled expenditures: "incurring a minimum of $1,400,000 in exploration expenditures on the Project as follows: (i) $300,000... (ii) $300,000... (iii) $300,000... and (iv) $500,000..."

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: No Net Smelter Royalty (NSR) or similar royalty is mentioned as part of the transaction terms.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The total area of the project is stated in hectares: "The Princeton Project consists of 29 mineral tenures totaling approximately 28,560 ha (70,570 acres)..."

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the coverage area is specified as hectares: "The Princeton Project consists of 29 mineral tenures totaling approximately 28,560 ha (70,570 acres)..."

resource_size.justification: The text mentions a resource for the nearby Copper Mountain Mine ('Proven and Probable Mineral Reserve of 702 Mt of 0.24% Copper'), but does not state any mineral resource for the Princeton Project itself.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's ticker and exchange are provided in the text: "COLLECTIVE METALS INC. (CSE:COMT| FSE:TO1) (the “Company” or “Collective”)..."
